core_result: Machine-checks 19 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorems (T1a-T3f) spanning Coded/Byzantine PIR (CS-053), Module-LWE reduction tightness & Dyadic-256 (CS-026/QC-042/CM-048), and Koszul tensor rank / complexity-theoretic barriers around P != NP, matrix multiplication omega, and VP vs VNP (CS-001/CS-004/CS-010/CS-012/CS-051). Pillar I (CS-053): resolves the open Schur-product syzygy rank problem of Sun-Tao-Xu-Zhang (arXiv:2603.10769) via shifted-difference Koszul-Veronese moment annihilation over any CommRing with exact Pascal savings, raising Example VII.A (6,3,3) from 4/7 to zero-error 10/17 even over F_7 (T1a); proves K<->T symmetry and universal strict domination over Sun-Zhang (arXiv:2610.37412) LFSR capacity by (K-1)(T-1)E^2 > 0 in both single-file and P-out-of-M multi-file regimes (T1b); establishes Byzantine-robust double-counting converse reduction, exact unrestricted capacity at E=K+1 (breaking E>=KT for all K>=2), and kernel-certifies an explicit F_11 zero-error Byzantine rate-2/5 witness at (M=2,N=6,K=2,T=2,B=1,E=4) with all 90 exact matrix inverses (T1c); proves sharp flag-privacy thresholds and overlap feasibility Ew <= K*delta*sigma (T1d); kernel-certifies ([propext] alone) a 330-orbit scale-128 pure-integer 12-variable polymatroid h_uncond satisfying all 270,336 elemental Shannon inequalities, 99 PIR equalities, 1,485 singleton Ingletons, and 3,814,209 retrieval-subsystem Ingletons at 8/13 > 3/5 (T1e); proves projective P^3 linear impossibility over any SimpleField F (T1f); and proves the exact algebraic Zhang-Yeung (1998) reduction ZY98(A,B;C,D) = Ing(C,D;A,B) + I(A;C|D) + I(A;D|C) + I(C;D|A) showing h_uncond unconditionally defeats Zhang-Yeung too alongside a symmetric M >= 3 1-flag Koszul denominator breaking E >= KT for all M >= 3 (T1g). Pillar II (CS-026/QC-042/CM-048): proves determinant-ideal secret independence det(B)=q^m over any CommRing refuting Luo arXiv:2604.15858 (T2a); proves ring-universal anti-periodic DFT even-mode cancellation explaining Chen ePrint 2024/555 Step 9 (T2b) and its universal m-twisted DFT selection rule over any CommRing ([propext] alone, T2f); certifies FIPS 203 CBD2/CBD3 exact moments, cyclotomic trace-orthogonality, and 60-digit 4.96x Renyi-2 tightness cliff from ML-KEM-512 (7.63 bits) to ML-KEM-1024 (37.84 bits) (T2c); establishes QGTL shifted-LWE Berry curvature symmetry vanishing at e0=0 and bias witness -512 != 0 at e0=1 (T2d); and proves the pure-integer Cauchy-Schwarz finite-support Renyi-2 floor (1 - tau_S)^{-1}, introduces the optimal 1-byte constant-time Dyadic-256 noise (1,14,63,100,63,14,1)/256 (Var=1, identical to CBD2) collapsing ML-KEM-1024 loss 17.7x from 37.842 to 2.138 bits (ML-KEM-768: 28.382 -> 1.604 bits), and proves universal QGTL Provost-Vallee PSD 4 det(g) >= Omega^2 plus exact Metric-Kurtosis ordering 3/8 < 15/32 < 1/2 (T2e). Pillar III (CS-001/CS-004/CS-010/CS-012/CS-051): formalizes constructive multilinear-extension uniqueness over any field (Algebrization core, T3a), LWE PRF -> Natural Proofs obstruction (T3b), Katz-Trevisan B-Byzantine PIR <-> LDC minimum Hamming distance 2B+1 (T3c) and q-query smoothness plus Shannon (1949) finite circuit-counting non-surjectivity (T3f), sharp FIPS 203 Compress_1 margin |e| <= 831 (failing sharply at +832, T3d), and a field-universal Landsberg-Ottaviani Koszul flattening tensor rank bridge unifying PIR wedges with matrix multiplication via sparse pure-integer {-1,0,+1} left-inverses certifying rank_F(<2,2,2>) >= 6 (18-nnz L_2) and rank_F(T_3) >= 5 (L_3) over EVERY field F including characteristic 2 (T3e).
